validated_contract.layout: one ordinary root-owned frame is zero-filled before common queue fields are programmed; the driver makes no descriptor/avail/used-ring byte write
validated_contract.notification: validated M8 scalar notification address is page-contained, mapped only to its root-local page, written exactly once as 16-bit queue value zero, then unmapped
validated_contract.queue_state: queue zero has non-zero maximum size, queue_size=1 and three layout address pairs read back; queue_enable reads 0, is written/read back 1 once, then reads 0 after immediate reset
validated_contract.teardown: status resets to zero and all notification/common/layout mappings, reservations and frames are released before return
validated_contract.authority: no copied capability, driver domain, descriptor publication, completion/interrupt handling, PCI command or bus-mastering write, IOSpace/DMA authority or DMA/containment claim

not_claimed: a usable virtqueue, descriptor publication or consumption, available/used-ring semantics, completion, IRQ, MSI-X, DMA behavior, DMA absence, DMA containment, IOMMU/IOSpace policy, hardware safety or retained queue state

block request, block read/write/flush, durable media access, persistent VFS, filesystem, storage server, Linux block/KAPI compatibility, Linux kernel, native Linux module execution, clone/fork/pthread, ELF runtime, dpkg or apt
